reason: Both are energy companies selling fuel to commercial and consumer buyers and running regional fuel logistics and distribution assets. Par Pacific's core is refining crude into transportation fuels (gasoline, diesel, jet), sold wholesale and at its own stations. Ferrellgas distributes propane, mainly for home heating, and does not refine. Their products differ: propane and cylinders versus refined transport fuels. Their main customers also differ: Ferrellgas serves homes and farms, Par serves airlines, wholesalers and motorists. The overlap is partial (fuel distribution, some commercial and industrial buyers, some retail), so this is adjacent rather than direct.
